mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals robust consumer spending that directly boosts corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through earnings momentum.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS rises (vs. baseline 34.1% negative days).

mechanism_narrative: A Federal Funds Rate exceeding 2.5% signals aggressive monetary tightening that increases discount rates for equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and rise in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals labor market tightening that accelerates consumer spending and corporate profit growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: The UNRATE decline/PAYEMS rise interaction fails: 60-day returns are negative in >55% of instances where both conditions occur.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO) during supply expansion indicates manufacturing capacity utilization growth that supports corporate output and margins, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >55% of periods when INDPRO rises during supply expansion regime.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) falling below 1,300,000 units signals residential sector contraction that reduces household wealth and consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >55% of periods when HOUST < 1300.0.

mechanism_narrative: Rising CPIAUCSL indicates persistent inflation that pressures the Fed to tighten policy, reducing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in >55% of periods when CPIAUCSL rises.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 4.5% signals economic weakness that reduces consumer confidence and corporate earnings growth, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >55% of periods when UNRATE > 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and rise in real personal consumption (RSAFS) signals demand reallocation from housing to consumption, stabilizing economic growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: The HOUST decline/RSAFS rise interaction fails: 60-day returns are negative in >55% of instances where both conditions occur.
